author: oot_dogwater
quote:
A masterpiece in the making.

GTA VI looks like everything a modern open-world game should aspire to be. The level of detail, incredible visuals, immersive world, and attention to even the smallest environmental elements make it feel like a massive leap forward for gaming.

Vice City looks absolutely alive, with a world that feels dynamic rather than just being a giant map filled with repetitive activities. The characters, atmosphere, storytelling, and overall presentation have the potential to make this one of the most memorable gaming experiences ever.

Rockstar clearly isn't interested in simply making another GTA game. They're aiming to redefine what an open-world experience can be.

If the final game delivers on what's been shown so far, GTA VI could easily become a generation-defining title.

The wait better be worth it, because the expectations are already through the roof.

author: oot_dogwater
quote:
A massively overrated game.

I genuinely don't understand why Ocarina of Time is considered one of the greatest games ever made. The controls feel clunky, the combat is repetitive, the camera is frustrating, and the constant backtracking gets tedious very quickly. The puzzles can be unnecessarily confusing, and some dungeons feel more like a test of patience than actual fun.

I understand that it was revolutionary for its time, but being historically important doesn't automatically make it enjoyable today. Nostalgia seems to be doing a lot of heavy lifting when people praise this game.

It's not necessarily a terrible game, but calling it a masterpiece in 2026 feels like giving it credit for things it did decades ago rather than judging the actual experience.

A legendary game historically, but nowhere near as enjoyable as its reputation suggests.
